review: 701.35a-2: the base variant carried a non-empty delta, its two variants changed both the turn and the action checked (attack, then block), and no library fed the draw steps; rebuilt it on Prodigal Pyromancer so only the turn of the check changes, B's turn (can't attack or activate) against A's next upkeep (can activate), and gave both players libraries

scenarios.title: A detained creature can't block
decisions: A casts Azorius Arrester, tapping both Plains.
Both players pass; Arrester enters and its trigger targets Grizzly Bears.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves and detains Grizzly Bears.
A moves to combat and attacks B with Hill Giant. In the declare blockers step B can declare blockers.

variants.label: detained
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is not a legal blocker. Elite Vanguard is a legal blocker.

variants.label: other_detained
variants.delta: Arrester's trigger targets Elite Vanguard instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Elite Vanguard is not a legal blocker. Grizzly Bears is a legal blocker.

operation.unclassifiable: The trigger takes a different target; no fork operation changes a target.

detector.outcome: A creature an effect forbids from blocking, as detain does, stands outside the legal blockers list.
detector.near_miss: A creature nothing forbids from blocking stands inside the legal blockers list.

scenarios.title: Detain lasts through the opponent's turn and ends when the detaining player's next turn begins

setup.notes: Library lists are ordered top first; they exist so that both draw steps have a card to draw.

decisions: A casts Azorius Arrester, tapping both Plains.
Both players pass; Arrester enters and its trigger targets Prodigal Pyromancer.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves and detains Prodigal Pyromancer.
A makes no attack and passes the turn.
In B's main phase 1 B has priority, then B moves to combat and declares attackers; the check is made there.

variants.label: opponent_turn
variants.expected: B can't activate Prodigal Pyromancer's {T} ability (can_play false), and Prodigal Pyromancer is not a legal attacker. Elite Vanguard is a legal attacker.

variants.label: detainer_next_turn
variants.delta: B makes no attack and passes the turn; the check is made in A's next upkeep, with B holding priority.
variants.expected: B can activate Prodigal Pyromancer's {T} ability (can_play true).

operation.unclassifiable: The check moves to the detaining player's next turn; no fork operation changes the turn or step.

detector.outcome: A candidate action a restriction forbids, such as a detained permanent's activated ability before its detainer's next turn, has can_play false.
detector.near_miss: A candidate action no restriction forbids has can_play true.

scenarios.title: A detained permanent's activated abilities can't be activated
decisions: A casts Azorius Arrester, tapping both Plains.
Both players pass; Arrester enters and its trigger targets Prodigal Pyromancer.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves and detains Prodigal Pyromancer. B receives priority.

variants.label: pyromancer_detained
variants.expected: B can't activate Prodigal Pyromancer's {T} ability (can_play false).

variants.label: bears_detained
variants.delta: Arrester's trigger targets Grizzly Bears instead of Prodigal Pyromancer.
variants.expected: B can activate Prodigal Pyromancer's {T} ability (can_play true).

operation.unclassifiable: The trigger takes a different target; no fork operation changes a target.

detector.outcome: An activated ability a restriction forbids, such as a detained permanent's, has can_play false.
detector.near_miss: An activated ability no restriction forbids has can_play true.
